name: ASTRA MILITARUM: CADIAN HEAVY WEAPONS SQUAD
description: Heavy Weapons Squads are teams of gun crews that can swiftly set up their arsenal of portable armaments. They bolster battle lines and provide close fire support with adaptable loadouts of precise or indiscriminate firepower. While massed infantry can overwhelm the foe, it often falls to these teams to deliver the killing blow.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds three Heavy Weapons Teams – paired infantry soldiers crewing portable guns – for your Astra Militarum armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Each team can be armed with your choice of a heavy bolter, missile launcher, mortar, autocannon, or lascannon, meaning you'll always have the right weapon for the right target. Whichever weapon choice you go for, you'll be able to rain down fire on your enemies before they get close. The kit includes multiple cosmetic options to personalise your miniatures, making it easy to customise your weapon teams.</br></br>This kit comprises 127 plastic components, 3x Citadel 50mm Round Bases, and 1x Cadian Infantry Transfer Sheet containing 597 high-quality waterslide transfers to decorate your miniatures. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
